scope: Batches 1–2: English / Traditional Chinese interface, English default, retained M8 / ACP / E1 and legacy data.

build.note: Vite emits a non-fatal large-chunk advisory; both bundled locales are available synchronously when switching.

browser_checks: First use opens in English; explicit Traditional Chinese choice survives reload.
Switching preserves the current search, unsent assistant draft, dirty table-cell text and focused input.
Selecting 待審核 saves Pending Review; switching displays the corresponding English label.
M8 board, four built-in specialist labels, crew settings and five saved workflow nodes remain available.
Flow controls, keyboard accessibility descriptions and server-rendered sign-in switch languages.
Existing production/page titles and documents remain untouched; the temporary table draft was canceled.
compatibility: No project-data or schema migration. English and legacy Chinese status wire values remain valid.
M8 / ACP tool keys, permissions, agent routing and lease behavior remain stable.
API errors retain their error and policy code fields, adding message_key and message_params when recognized.
limits: Unknown external/provider errors retain their original readable fallback.
No real external model/ACP adapter calls, Docker run or remote CI run in this interface-only phase.
